title: Run ledger line
description: One line of .specify/runs/<run>/ledger.jsonl: one step of a run, appended by `record`, the approval hook, the guard (guard-off) or the runner, never rewritten. Each line is chained to the one before by a SHA-256 hash (rules WG-15, WG-16 in schemas/workflow-graph.schema.md). Public, experimental.

prev.description: The previous line's hash; on line 1, the SHA-256 of the run id

hash.description: SHA-256 of prev followed by this line's JSON without hash

at.description: UTC time the line was written

node.description: Graph node id, e.g. P0, G2, P6.execute

result.description: What happened: a path id at P0, done, pass, fail, approved, changes-requested, guard-off …

actor.description: Who wrote the step; human only for approvals

evidence.description: Paths produced or checked; never contents

quote.description: The person's exact words, for gate approvals

source.description: Where the approval came from, e.g. UserPromptSubmit, userPromptSubmitted, terminal

session.description: The coding agent's session id the approval was typed in

log.description: The session log that holds the quote, checked by verify-approvals

gen_ai.workflow.name.description: The graph's name (OpenTelemetry GenAI attribute), e.g. agentic-sdlc

gen_ai.agent.name.description: The role agent that did the step, when known

usage.description: Tokens and cost of the step, from the turn token report; left out when unknown
